Subject: CloudVault CAIQ request — integration readiness (deadline Aug 9)

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the integration looks promising. We have a security review with the procurement and security teams next month and need a completed CAIQ (Cloud Security Alliance) response and representative evidence. Our reviewer asked for the following:

- Completed CAIQ spreadsheet (CSV/XLS) mapped to our control IDs
- Representative artifacts: system diagrams, runtime logs, sample access logs, key rotation policy, and any SOC 2 report excerpts
- A single point of contact and an internal owner for each control mapped

Deadline: EOD Aug 9 (their audit window opens Aug 12).

I attached our CAIQ template (CloudVault-CAIQ-2027.xlsx) with a few notes in column F where they want additional context. Can you confirm whether you can deliver an initial mapping and the suggested artifacts by Aug 9? If it helps, we can schedule a 30m call for a quick tie-out.

Appreciate it — Evan

--

Senior Security Engineer
CloudVault Inc.

Evan — thanks for the clear ask and the template. We can meet the timeline with a scoped deliverable plan. High-level approach below; detailed owners and artifacts attached (CAIQ-extraction-template.csv).

Plan (deliver by Aug 9):
1) Intake & scope (today–Jul 30): confirm which CloudVault control IDs need narrative vs artifact.
2) Extraction sprint (Jul 31–Aug 4): our compliance team will run a focused extraction for controls that require runtime artifacts (logs, diagrams).
3) Owner validation (Aug 5–Aug 7): internal owners review mapped answers and attest to accuracy.
4) Final assembly & handoff (Aug 8): produce completed spreadsheet and a zip of sampled artifacts.

Owners (first pass):
- Naomi Feldman — Identity & access controls, rotation (will provide access logs sample)
- Alex Martinez — Network & infra diagrams, runtime collection scripts
- Tessa Morgan — Overall QA, final narrative edits, and package delivery

Attachments I added: CAIQ-extraction-template.csv (blank columns for owner, evidence link, and sample file name). Alex/Naomi — please populate your rows by EOD Aug 4.

If the CloudVault reviewers want a short technical tie-out call, I can carve out 08/06 or 08/09 morning PST — let me know which works.

Thanks,
